zones.title: 1. Product Agent
zones.body: Called by the intake workflow with the order id and the extracted lines. The agent may only use the two catalogue tools and must return the structured shape; a hallucinated code cannot be returned because the parser schema and the verify step below both reject it.

zones.title: 2. Deterministic verify and log
zones.body: Every code the agent chose is re-read from the catalogue. Lines are marked verified, ambiguous, not_found or unverified_code; quantities over 80 are flagged as Elephant Order. The tool calls are written to step_log as the agent's reflection trace.
